text.en:
Subsection (u) of section eighty-four of Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred and
sixty-six is amended to read as follows:
"(u) The term 'alien' and 'foreign government' shall be deemed to include the citizens and Government of the
United States, including the political subdivisions thereof: Provided, however, That citizens of the United
States residing in the Philippines shall not be subject to taxation under this Title as to their compensation
paid-by-the Government of the United States or political subdivisions thereof-for personal services rendered
in the Philippines in compliance with orders from the Government of the United States, and as to their
incomes derived from sources within the United States, and no return thereof is required to be made."

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nineteen hundred and forty.
Approved, April 18, 1940.
